canonical.heading: SpaceXAI Grok 4.6 now available on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US)
canonical.summary: Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US) now supports SpaceXAI Grok 4.6, a frontier model built for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work. canonical.heading: Amazon Bedrock announces reduced pricing for OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol
canonical.summary: Today, OpenAI announced that they are lowering API prices for GPT-5.6 Sol. Following the recent Terra and Luna price reductions, Sol now costs $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens—20% lower input pricing and 33.3% lower output pricing. canonical.heading: Launching External Web Access for Web Search on Amazon Bedrock
canonical.summary: Earlier this month, we announced Web Search on Amazon Bedrock , a built-in server-side tool that allows you to ground model responses with current web knowledge, while maintaining data within your secured AWS environment with zero data egress. canonical.heading: AWS Cost Anomaly Detection supports third-party models on Amazon Bedrock
